text: Require an accepted snapshot before expiry; a missing or ambiguous snapshot leaves the period BLOCKED, not partially expired.
criteria: Trigger with no accepted snapshot: BLOCKED and no membership expiry.

text: Apply each valid renewal once, never shorten validity, and isolate unknown-member or conflicting renewal records as discrepancies.
criteria: Reapply SN-01; M-A has one renewal effect, M-X is a discrepancy, and shortening validity is rejected/isolated.

text: Expire only eligible memberships under the accepted cutoff; create at most one reminder per member/period/kind.
criteria: At April 2, keep renewed M-A and inclusive-date M-B ACTIVE; expire M-C and produce one reminder despite repeated run invocation.

text: Checkpoint bounded pages and resume after failure without skipping members or repeating accepted effects.
criteria: Crash after a page update but before advancing the cursor; resume and compare with an uninterrupted reference run.

text: Allow an authorized operator to resolve/replay discrepancies while preserving original run inputs and results.
criteria: Resolve M-X through an authorized correction revision; preserve SN-01 and its original discrepancy evidence.

text: Under nominal conditions, process 2000 memberships within five minutes and account for each input in a result/discrepancy count.
criteria: Reconcile all 2000 records with balanced counts and measured duration.
